site_bundlesequence.description: Ordered list of CFEngine policy bundles to execute on each agent run

site_include_paths.description: List of CFEngine input policy files to include before main bundlesequence

site_cfengine_control_host.description: Target host class for this control block (e.g., 'any', 'servers', 'workstations')

site_cfengine_control_vars.description: CFEngine control variable definitions (e.g., file rotation, timeouts, defaults)

site_trusted_servers.description: Comma-separated list of trusted policy server IPs or hostnames

site_trusted_users.description: Comma-separated list of system users allowed to connect to the CFEngine server

site_trusted_groups.description: Comma-separated list of system groups allowed to connect to the CFEngine server

site_policy_server_key.description: Path to the public key used to verify signatures on received promises

site_execd_timeout.description: Maximum execution time (in seconds) per command run by cf-execd

site_execd_max_processes.description: Maximum number of concurrent processes cf-execd will launch

site_cf_serverd_port.description: TCP port used by cf-serverd for incoming connections

site_cf_execd_port.description: TCP port used by cf-execd for local communication (rarely used)

site_cf_monitord_port.description: TCP port used by cf-monitord for status collection

site_policy_server_host.description: Hostame or IP of the primary CFEngine policy server

site_policy_server_dir.description: Directory on the policy server from which agents download policies

site_log_dir.description: Directory where CFEngine daemon logs are stored

site_log_rotate_count.description: Number of old log files to retain during rotation

site_log_size_limit.description: Maximum size (in bytes) of a single log file before rotation

site_verbose.description: Enable verbose logging (increases log detail for debugging)

site_packages_enabled.description: Enable package management promises (e.g., installing system packages)

site_packages_list.description: List of packages to ensure installed

restart.description: Restart policy when service is found dead (e.g., 'immediate', 'delayed', 'none')

site_monitored_services.description: List of services to monitor and optionally auto-restart
